emergency.title: When violence happens in digital spaces
emergency.description: You do not have to resolve everything at once. Start with safe steps and choose information based on your situation.
emergency.disclaimer: This general guide is not a substitute for legal assistance, specialized technical support, or emergency services.

ncii.title: Someone is threatening to share intimate photos or videos
ncii.introduction: You do not have to comply with the perpetrator's threats. Prioritize your safety and preserve evidence if it is safe to do so.
steps: Do not rush to pay or send additional content.
Save threatening messages, account names, links, and timestamps if it is safe.
Report the content through the platform's official channels. StopNCII.org may help eligible adults prevent certain intimate images from being shared.

doxing.title: Personal information has been shared without permission
doxing.introduction: Sharing an address, phone number, or other personal information can increase safety risks. You have the right to seek help.
steps: Document the post and its links if it is safe to do so.
Review your privacy settings and secure your account using a device you trust.
Report the content to the platform and consider legal assistance if there are threats or harm.
doxing.actionLabel: Understand forms of online gender-based violence

stalking.title: You suspect that your account or device is being monitored
stalking.introduction: If you suspect monitoring by someone who may put you at risk, avoid actions that could increase the danger.
steps: Use a safer device to seek help if possible.
Check login sessions, location sharing, and app permissions only if it is safe.
Record suspicious incidents and seek trusted technical assistance before deleting apps that may contain evidence.

deepfake.title: Your face or identity has been used in a fake image
deepfake.introduction: Manipulated images can be used to humiliate, threaten, or extort someone. You are not responsible for the perpetrator's actions.
steps: Save links and information about the accounts sharing the image if it is safe.
Avoid resharing the image, especially intimate content.
Use the platform's reporting channels and seek support to determine your next steps.

approach.title: Support that respects each person's choices.
approach.description: Everyone has different circumstances, needs, and safety considerations. A good response begins with listening, respecting the decisions of affected people, and providing clear information about available options.

listen.title: Listen
listen.description: Start with the experiences and needs of the affected person.

options.title: Offer options

cta.description: Start by reading the information you need or contacting the organization to ask about available support options.
cta.supportDescription: Community solidarity helps sustain empowerment and advocacy work.

hero.title: Change begins when everyone
hero.description: Transformasi Perempuan Dotcom works to empower women and strengthen community capacity. We promote access to knowledge, meaningful participation, and safer, more inclusive use of technology.

vision.title: An empowered, equal, and inclusive society.
vision.description: We believe that opportunities to learn, participate, and access rights should be open to everyone.
vision.highlight: Technology and development should expand opportunities, not create new barriers.
missions: Strengthen women's empowerment by improving digital literacy and capacity.
Increase public understanding of human rights, equality, and the protection of vulnerable groups.
Encourage the participation of women, young people, persons with disabilities, and older people in development.
Advocate for the fulfillment of rights, equal access, and a fairer society.

values.title: It is not only about what we do, but also how we do it.
values.description: How we work together is just as important as the goals we aim to achieve. Every activity should respect people's dignity, choices, and diverse experiences.

human.title: People-centered
human.description: We listen to everyone's experiences without judgment. The dignity, choices, and needs of the people we support are our primary considerations.

consent.title: Consent and control
consent.description: We provide clear information so everyone can understand the available options and decide on steps that suit their needs.

privacy.title: Protecting privacy
privacy.description: Personal information must be handled carefully. Data collection, use, and sharing should always consider consent and security.

inclusion.title: Inclusive justice
inclusion.description: We recognize differences in experiences, access, and barriers faced by women, children, persons with disabilities, and other groups.

structure.title: TPDotcom organizational structure
structure.description: TPDotcom is run through collaboration between operational staff, members, the core management team, the chairperson, and the supervisory board. Each has a role and responsibility in supporting the organization and achieving shared goals.

executive.title: Executive Director
executive.description: The operational leader responsible for directing, managing, and ensuring that all organizational activities align with the organization's goals and work plans.

coordinator.title: Coordinator
coordinator.description: Coordinates the technical, administrative, financial, and program implementation needs of the organization.

supervisor.title: Supervisory Board
supervisor.description: Oversees the organization and ensures that it operates in accordance with its vision, mission, and accountability principles.

chairperson.title: Chairperson
chairperson.description: Leads the organization's direction, coordination, and implementation.

core.title: Core Management Team
core.description: Manages coordination, administration, finance, and organizational governance.

members.title: Organization Members
members.description: Support the implementation of programs, activities, and various initiatives for women's empowerment and community development.

accountability.title: Trust is built through transparency and responsibility.
accountability.description: Information about our organization, programs, and publications helps the public understand TPDotcom's work and the activities we carry out.

information.title: Clear information

responsibility.title: Shared responsibility
responsibility.description: Encouraging responsible practices toward communities and partners.

documentation.description: Using publications to help the public follow the organization's activities and learning.
